tests.name: invalid signature and invalid native bytes reject before any pool connection even without schema
schema is never auto-created; missing/disabled/legacy/wrong epoch control fails closed
actual durable message is minimized and canonical reordered replay returns the same committed receipt
two actual concurrent receivers and a new process instance create one unique bot/update record
unsupported event variants are durably ignored with private_input NULL and no unnecessary PII
callback sender bot/actor and exact native UTF-8 callback bytes are validated before DB
ACK remains unavailable while actual COMMIT is held; other connections cannot see uncommitted ingress
exact recovery waits for an in-flight accept then sees its commit; RR override negative control misses it
saved and not-saved ambiguous COMMIT return no ACK and recover/retry exactly once
failure after actual insert rolls back ingress and returns no ACK; corrupt private work never passes recovery
epoch rollover never auto-reassigns or acknowledges old durable work; fresh current-epoch input works
ingress never touches canonical profile/domain/outbox tables, provider API, or legacy writers

scope: Fresh own cluster/native synthetic payload only; no identity/profile/send/consume/API or production activation. RR override is an explicit QA negative control.
